# shadcn stylesheet attribution

`src/styles/shadcn.css` is the unmodified `dist/tailwind.css` from the MIT-licensed
`shadcn` npm package at version 4.7.0. Source repository:
https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/tree/shadcn%404.7.0/packages/shadcn.

The upstream copyright and permission notice are retained in `LICENSE.md` here.
This project keeps the small static stylesheet locally so its build does not need
to install the component-generation CLI and its dependency tree. Existing local
UI components retain their original imports and styles.
